body.description: Filaglow: a tiny light bulb creature, clear glass head with a glowing coiled filament like a wisp of hair and eyes, a screw-thread metal base as its body, hopping on the threads, warm amber glow, gentle. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
